about: Every field of the contract belongs to exactly one intent level. A level's view of the contract = its own fields + all lower levels. The difference between two levels is therefore a known set of fields.

levels.summary: Names, types, values, references, props signatures, lifecycle status. Everything a deterministic gate (lint, type-check) can verify. Always present; the baseline of every experiment.
One-line statements of role: what a token, component or prop is for.
Usage tags, do/don't rules, pairings, when to use and when not to, accessibility requirements.
Curated positive examples, composition recipes, anti-patterns.
